title.en: Internet, web, IoT and the domain name system
title.kn: ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲ, ವೆಬ್, IoT ಮತ್ತು ಡೊಮೇನ್ ಹೆಸರು ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ

heading.en: Typing a name, reaching a machine

hook.en: You type a website name, not a string of numbers, yet your browser finds the right server in another country. Who looked up the number for you?
hook.kn: ನೀವು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನಲ್ಲ, ಜಾಲತಾಣದ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಟೈಪ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೀರಿ; ಆದರೂ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್ ಬೇರೆ ದೇಶದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಸರ್ವರ್ ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿದವರು ಯಾರು?

objectives.en: Distinguish the Internet from the WWW

narration.en: You type a website name, not a string of numbers, yet your browser finds the right server in another country. Who looked up the number for you?
narration.kn: ನೀವು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನಲ್ಲ, ಜಾಲತಾಣದ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಟೈಪ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೀರಿ; ಆದರೂ ಬ್ರೌಸರ್ ಬೇರೆ ದೇಶದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಸರ್ವರ್ ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿದವರು ಯಾರು?

body.en: The Internet is the global network of networks. The World Wide Web (WWW) is a service on the Internet: a huge collection of web pages linked by hyperlinks. It rests on three technologies: HTML to create pages, URI/URL to give each resource a unique address, and HTTP to transfer pages between servers and browsers. The Internet of Things (IoT) connects everyday devices, such as smart meters, watches, cameras and appliances, so they can collect and exchange data.

points.en: Internet = network of networks; WWW = service on it

narration.en: The Internet is the network of networks, and the Web is one service on it, built from HTML, URLs and HTTP. IoT connects everyday devices.
narration.kn: ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲ ಜಾಲಗಳ ಜಾಲ; ವೆಬ್ ಅದರ ಮೇಲಿನ ಒಂದು ಸೇವೆ, HTML, URL, HTTP ಗಳಿಂದ ನಿರ್ಮಿತ. IoT ದೈನಂದಿನ ಸಾಧನಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: How DNS finds ncert.nic.in

say.en: A domain name is read from right to left. dot in is the top-level domain, nic is the second level, ncert is the host.
Computers need the IP address. The browser asks a DNS resolver.
If the resolver does not know, it asks a root server, then the dot in server, then nic’s own name server.
The name server returns the IP address. The browser then connects to that address with HTTP.
The web rests on three ideas: HTML for pages, URLs for addresses, and HTTP to carry them.

narration.en: We read a domain name from right to left and follow a DNS query from the browser to the name servers and back.

body.en: Computers find each other by IP address, but people remember names. A domain name such as ncert.nic.in is read from right to left: .in is the top-level domain, nic is the second level. The Domain Name System (DNS) translates domain names into IP addresses; this is called name resolution. When you type a URL, your computer asks a DNS server; if it does not know, the query passes through root servers, top-level domain servers and the domain's own name server until the IP address is found.

points.en: Domain name → IP address = name resolution
Read domains right to left: TLD first

narration.en: DNS turns a domain name into an IP address. This is called name resolution, and it works through a hierarchy of servers from the root down.
narration.kn: DNS ಡೊಮೇನ್ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು IP ವಿಳಾಸವಾಗಿ ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದನ್ನು ಹೆಸರು ಪರಿಹಾರ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ; ರೂಟ್‌ನಿಂದ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಸರ್ವರ್ ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: Break the URL https://www.example.in/admission/form.html into its parts.

steps.en: https → protocol used to fetch the page (secure HTTP).
www.example.in → domain name; .in is the top-level domain.
/admission/form.html → path to the page on the server.
DNS converts www.example.in into the server's IP address before the page is fetched.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Break the URL https://www.example.in/admission/form.html into its parts.

body.en: The web needs a page, an address and a postman: HTML is the page, URL is the address, HTTP is the postman.

DNS converts domain names to IP addresses.

narration.en: Recap. The WWW is a service that runs on the Internet. HTML makes pages, URL addresses them, HTTP transfers them. IoT connects everyday devices to exchange data. DNS converts domain names to IP addresses.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. WWW ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ನಡೆಯುವ ಒಂದು ಸೇವೆ. HTML ಪುಟ ರಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, URL ವಿಳಾಸ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ, HTTP ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. IoT ದೈನಂದಿನ ಸಾಧನಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. DNS ಡೊಮೇನ್ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು IP ವಿಳಾಸವಾಗಿ ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
